items.author: Aaron Levie
items.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
items.summary_en:
Jev will be super helpful for agents to make split second decisions in workflows, data classification, judgment calls, and hundreds of other use-cases in the enterprise.

Here's a quick demo with Box and Jev to make that real. The demo pulls an incident report from Box, asks whether it's customer-facing and how severe it is, moves the file into escalate, monitor, or review folders, and sets a metadata template instance with the result. This all happens nearly instantly and at almost no cost.

You can imagine this in insurance claims, contract management, loan processing, security reviews, customer log analysis, and so on. Definitely a great new class of AI use-case.
items.summary_zh: Jev 让企业里的智能体能近乎零成本、瞬间完成判断：事故报告是否面向客户、严重程度如何、该升级还是监控。真正的价值不在 demo，而在保险理赔、合同、贷款、安全审查、日志分析这些需要快速分类和决策的流程里。

items.author: No Priors
items.title: Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference with Inception Co-Founder and CEO Stefano Ermon
items.summary_en:
Speaker 1 | 00:05 - 00:31
Hi, listeners. Welcome back to No Priors. Today, I'm here with Stefano Erman, who is a longtime Stanford professor and now co founder and CEO of Inception. Stefano has a extraordinarily broad body of work around generative modeling, but is especially well known as one of the fathers of diffusion. We talk about his company challenging the large labs and why speed and efficiency are going to be the name of the game in AI over the next few years.

Speaker 1 | 00:31 - 00:35
Welcome, Stefano. Stefano, thanks so much for being here.

Speaker 2 | 00:35 - 00:35
Great to be here.

Speaker 1 | 00:35 - 00:42
I would love for us to just start with a little bit of your research background and how you ended up starting your company.

Speaker 2 | 00:42 - 01:01
For sure. Yeah. I've been doing research in generative models for like basically my entire career. I started at Stanford in 2014 as an assistant professor, I was working on building generative models. Back then, the the research area was not particularly hot.

Speaker 2 | 01:01 - 01:35
You know, the the the models were not quite working well. We were still, like, building little generative models over MNIST, and it was, like, a big success if you could generate these grainy images of digits. And it was even hard to publish papers back then on that topic, and you had to justify training a generative model as a way to learn features from unlabeled data that then could maybe help you do better at supervised learning because that was the thing that everybody cared about. But then things took over, of course. And so it was at the right place at the right time working on the right thing.

Speaker 2 | 01:35 - 01:40
And so I've been doing research in that space since the beginning, basically.

Speaker 1 | 01:40
items.summary_zh: Stefano Ermon 从生成模型还只能做粗糙 MNIST 数字、论文都难发的时候就押注这个方向；现在扩散模型成了 AI 主战场，他的判断是：接下来几年，AI 竞争的核心不再只是模型更大，而是谁能把推理做得更快、更便宜、更高效。
